title: Organization Stealth Ship
summary: The Organization Stealth Ship is a large, silver maritime vessel used by the Organization to transport operatives for missions across open water.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The stealth ship was used by [[Wilder]] and his men to travel to the coast of [[England]] undetected as they followed the Huntik team on their mission to the [[Crystal Caves]] to find the location of [[Avalon]]. It was stationed near the cliffs, as Wilder and [[Stack]] plotted to attack the Huntik team. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}}

Wilder's team later used the stealth ship in Japan, travelling across the ocean in preparation for them diving down to find the underwater city of Yonaguni. {{Source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

sections.heading: Design
sections.wikitext:
The stealth ship has an angular geometric design, with flat surfaces, and a minimal superstructure to allow it go undetected by radar and sonar. The vessel sits low in the water and lacks exposed railings or equipment, giving it a discreet and utilitarian appearance. Its visual design is consistent with the other advanced vehicles used by the Organization.

full_text:
The Organization Stealth Ship is a large, silver maritime vessel used by the Organization to transport operatives for missions across open water. 

== History ==
The stealth ship was used by Wilder and his men to travel to the coast of England undetected as they followed the Huntik team on their mission to the Crystal Caves to find the location of Avalon. It was stationed near the cliffs, as Wilder and Stack plotted to attack the Huntik team. [Cave of the Casterwills]

Wilder's team later used the stealth ship in Japan, travelling across the ocean in preparation for them diving down to find the underwater city of Yonaguni. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

== Design ==
The stealth ship has an angular geometric design, with flat surfaces, and a minimal superstructure to allow it go undetected by radar and sonar. The vessel sits low in the water and lacks exposed railings or equipment, giving it a discreet and utilitarian appearance. Its visual design is consistent with the other advanced vehicles used by the Organization.
